تقترضن (form VIII)
# تَقْتَرِضْنَ (taqtariḍna) /taq.ta.ridˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
# تُقْتَرَضْنَ (tuqtaraḍna) /tuq.ta.radˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
